name: Ruthless Predator (Combat)
body:
When you find a small opening, tear it big enough to walk through.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Bluff 6 Ranks, Erudite Predator Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, Predator’s Cunning

Benefits: While you use this style, you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls with your unarmed strikes for every previous consecutive hit against any opponent in the same round. Creatures who roll a natural 1 on a saving throw within your reach provoke an attack of opportunity from you.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
